SELECT eventTime, eventName, eventSource, userIdentity.arn, userIdentity.type, userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.arn AS assumedRoleArn, requestParameters, recipientAccountId
FROM cloudtrail_events
WHERE eventName = 'DeleteRule'
  AND recipientAccountId = '274619035821'
  AND eventTime >= '2026-09-17T13:00:00Z'
  AND eventTime <= '2026-09-17T15:00:00Z'
ORDER BY eventTime ASC

SELECT eventTime, eventName, eventSource, userIdentity, requestParameters, responseElements
FROM cloudtrail_events
WHERE eventName = 'DeleteRule'
  AND recipientAccountId = '274619035821'
  AND eventTime >= '2026-09-17T13:00:00Z'
  AND eventTime <= '2026-09-17T15:00:00Z'
ORDER BY eventTime ASC
